name: BestPrice
description: Read-only shopping decisions, product search, offers, and price history for Greece.
instructions: Use BestPrice for physical products sold in Greece. get_shopping_decision answers what to buy, comparisons, and read-only basket plans. search_products finds a canonical product id. compare_offers needs that id and a Greek postcode for a delivered total. get_price_history classifies today's item price against the 180-day median. All four tools are read-only. Do not invent a product id, a shipping cost, or a merchant URL. Unknown shipping is unknown. Do not use BestPrice for travel, services, digital goods, checkout, or payment.
